author: Epic Games
description:
Roco Kingdom is a free-to-play, cross-platform, open-world creature-collecting RPG.

In this gameplay overview, take a closer look at what awaits in Carosia: discover and catch unique Jinies, build your lineup, take on PvE and PvP challenges, and explore with friends.

The Closed Beta Test (Quack Quack Test) begins on NOW! If you’ve secured a spot, don’t forget to log in. See you in Carosia!

Wishlist now! https://epic.gm/roco-kingdom
